spans.s: अद्य (I) n. Food, anything eatable.
अद्य (II) ind. Today, now, nowadays.
आद्य (I) a. (f. द्या) 1. First in position, preeminent, आसीन्महीक्षितामाद्यः प्रणवश्चन्दसामिव R.i.11; 2. first in time. (आद्य is often used as the last member of compounds in the same sense as आदि).
आद्य (II) n. Grain, food.
आद्य (I) a. (f. द्या) 1. First in position, preeminent, आसीन्महीक्षितामाद्यः प्रणवश्चन्दसामिव R.i.11; 2. first in time. (आद्य is often used as the last member of compounds in the same sense as आदि).
आद्या f. A name of Durgā.
अद्य-अपि ind. even now, to this day, अद्यापि नोज्झति हरः Ch.
. (Almost every stanza of Ch.P. begins with अद्यापि).
अद्य-अवधि ind. from or till today.
अद्य-एव ind. this very day.

अद्य-दिन n. the present day, e.g. अद्यदिनमारभ्य^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251226. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/104.

अद्य-दिवस m. the present day, e.g. अद्यदिनमारभ्य^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251226. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/104.
अद्य-पूर्वम् ind. before now.
अद्य-प्रभृति ind. from today, अद्यप्रभृत्यवनतांगि तवास्मि दासः K.S.v.86.
अद्य-श्वीन a. likely to happen today or tomorrow.
अद्य-श्वीना f. a female near delivery, अद्यश्वीनावष्टब्धे Pan.
अद्यतन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Extending over or referring to today; 2. modern.
अद्यतन (II) m. The period of a current day.
अद्यतन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Extending over or referring to today; 2. modern.
अद्यतन-भूत m. the aorist. See अनद्यतन.
अद्यतनीय a. (f. या) 1. Referring to today; 2. current, nowadays.
अद्यतनीय a. (f. या) 1. Referring to today; 2. current, nowadays.
आदि-अन्त n. beginning and end.
आदि-उदात्त a. having the acute accent on the first syllable.
आद्य-कवि m. the same as आदिकवि q.v.
आद्य-बीज n. प्रधान or the inanimate principle which is the material cause of the universe according to the Sāṅkhyas.
आद्योत m. Light, brilliance.
आद्यून a. (f. ना) Voracious, hungry.
आद्यून a. (f. ना) Voracious, hungry.
